blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: When two objects share a name, how much does their visual similarity explain, and what do the teaching examples add? First, we reanalyzed trial-level data from a large adult word-extension study (Lewis & Frank, 2018), computing each test image's distance to the examples shown in the space of a frozen self-supervised visual encoder (DINOv2). Distance was associated with extension (log odds -3.23 per standard deviation; 520 people), and an exploratory post hoc analysis suggested that this association persisted within the taught domain after controlling for taxonomic level and teaching condition. Example composition also mattered: after three examples, adults extended a word to 1.1% of superordinate items when the examples were subordinate and to 77.5% when they were superordinate. Second, in an artificial learner using the same encoder, words joining two categories were learned less accurately the farther apart the categories were (84.7%, 65.4%, and 53.0% naming accuracy for near, mid, and far pairs). The encoder's distances correlated with human similarity and confusability measures from three datasets (rho = .501-.795), but this representational alignment did not translate into conclusive evidence that human-derived distances predict learner difficulty, and a second encoder trained on one child's experience reproduced the tier ordering but not the pair-level effect. The secondary human data were analyzed under an internal plan fixed before the confirmatory analyses (not externally preregistered). Visual similarity accounts for part of how generalization is organized in both systems, while the composition of examples contributes what the distance we used does not capture.
blocks.zh: 当两个对象共用一个名字时,他们的视觉相似性能解释多少,而教学例子又会增加什么? 首先,我们从一个大型的成人词扩展研究(Lewis & Frank, 2018)中重新分析出实验级别数据,计算出每个测试图像的距离到被冷冻自控视觉编码器(DINOv2)空间中显示的例子. 距离与扩展有关(逻辑概率-每标准偏差3.23;520人),一项探索性事后分析表明,在控制分类水平和教学条件之后,这种关联在教学领域继续存在。 实例构成也很重要:在三个实例之后,成年人在实例从属时将一个字扩展至1.1%的上位项目;在实例从属时将一个字扩展至77.5%. 其次,在一个使用同一编码器的人工学习者中,将两个类别合并起来的词学得不准确,而分类之间的差别更大(84.7%、65.4%和53.0%对近、中和远对的命名准确性)。 编码器的距离与三个数据集(rho = 501-795)的人类相似性和相容性测量值相关,但这种代表式的对接没有转化成人源距离预测学习者难度的确凿证据,第二个受过儿童经验培训的编码器复制了分级顺序,而不是对等效应. 根据确认分析前确定的一项内部计划对次级人类数据进行了分析(不是外部预先登记)。 视觉相似性是两个系统中的通论组织方式的一部分,而实例的构成则贡献了我们使用的距离不捕捉的内容.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: A word can cover several kinds of objects and still be coherent. Children call cats and dogs doggie long before they call frogs and trucks by a common name ( Rescorla, 1980a ) , and adults told that three Dalmatians are all feps will typically refuse the label for a cow. Two kinds of explanation are usually offered for such patterns. Similarity-based accounts hold that a word spreads to referents that resemble its known instances ( Sloutsky & Fisher, 2004a ; Nosofsky, 1986a ) . Bayesian accounts hold that learners infer the most plausible extension from a structured hypothesis space, so that the composition of the examples, and not only their similarity to a test object, determines how far the word is extended ( Xu & Tenenbaum, 2007a ) . Developmental work shows both influences: children extend novel nouns by shape ( Landau et al., 1988a ) , construe them taxonomically rather than thematically ( Markman & Hutchinson, 1984a ) , and project properties by category membership over appearance ( Gelman & Markman, 1986a ) .
blocks.zh: 一个词可以覆盖几种对象,并且仍然具有连贯性. 儿童在用同名名字称呼青蛙和卡车(Rescorla, 1980a)之前很早就叫猫和狗狗了, 成年人说三个达尔马提亚人都是恶人, 这种模式通常有两种解释。 基于类似性的说法认为,一个词会传播给与已知案例相似的裁判(Sloutsky & Fisher,2004a;Nosofsky,1986a.)。 Bayesian的叙述认为,学习者从结构化假说空间推断出最可信的扩展,这样,实例的构成,而不仅仅是它们与测试对象的相似性,决定了这个词的延伸程度(Xu & Tenenenbaum, 2007a.) 。 。 。 。 发展工作显示了两种影响:儿童按形状推广出小说名词(Landau等,1988年a),按分类而不是按主题加以解释(Markman & Hutchinson,1984年a),以及按类别成员而不是外表划分的项目属性(Gelman & Markman,1986年a)。

blocks.en: This article asks a narrow version of this question: when two objects receive the same name, how much is explained by their visual similarity, and what do the examples used to teach the word contribute? Answering it requires a measure of visual similarity that is defined independently of the word-learning behavior under study and can be applied to the exact images people saw. Self-supervised vision models now provide such a measure. Their embedding spaces are learned without labels and can be queried for any image, and their geometry partly aligns with human similarity judgments ( Hebart et al., 2020a ; Roads & Love, 2021a ) . They are not models of human perception, and human similarity judgments themselves mix perceptual and conceptual information ( Hebart et al., 2020a ; Hebart et al., 2023a ) ; but they give an explicit, reproducible similarity space in which both human and artificial generalization can be described.
blocks.zh: 这篇文章问这个问题的狭义版本:当两个物体得到同名时,用它们的视觉相似性来解释多少,用什么例子来教导这个词的贡献? 回答它需要衡量视觉相似性,这种相似性的定义独立于正在研究的文字学习行为,可以被应用到人们所看到的准确图像上. 自我监督的愿景模型现在提供了这样的衡量标准。 他们的嵌入空间是没有标签学习的,可以询问任何图像,他们的几何部分与人类相似性判断一致(Hebart等,2020a;Roads & Love,2021a.). 它们不是人类认知的模型,人类相似性判断本身将感知信息和概念信息相混合(Hebart等,2020a; Hebart等,2023a;但它们提供了一种明确,可再生的相似性空间,其中既可以描述人性,也可以描述人为的概括.

blocks.en: A growing literature asks how far such representations align with human similarity and how alignment can be increased. Alignment with human similarity judgments varies across networks and depends more on training data and objective than on model scale or architecture ( Muttenthaler et al., 2023a ) . Representations can be made more human-like by fine-tuning on human perceptual similarity judgments ( Fu et al., 2023a ) , which also benefits several downstream vision tasks ( Sundaram et al., 2024a ) , or by transferring the hierarchical structure of human judgments across abstraction levels ( Muttenthaler et al., 2025a ) . We deliberately used a frozen encoder that was not aligned to human data, so that any convergence with human measures is not built in; the partial alignment we report should be read against this choice. We also used only the global (CLS) embedding of the final layer; intermediate layers and patch-level features may relate differently to human similarity and were not examined.
blocks.zh: 越来越多的文献询问,这种表述在多大程度上与人类相似,如何加强一致性。 与人类相似性判断的一致性因网络而异,更多地取决于培训数据和目标,而不是模型规模或结构(Muttenthaler等,2023a)。 。 。 。 。 通过微调人的感知相似性判断(Fu等,2023a),也可以使表现更像人,这也有利于几个下游的愿景任务(Sundaram等,2024a),或通过将人类判断的分级结构跨抽象层次转移(Muttenthaler等,2025a.). 我们故意使用一个与人类数据不相符合的被冻结的编码器,以便不建立与人类措施的趋同关系;我们报告的部分趋同应参照这一选择来阅读。 我们还只使用了最终地层的全球(CLS)嵌入;中间地层和补丁级特征可能与人类相似性不同,没有被检查.

blocks.en: We combine two sources of evidence. The first is human: we reanalyzed trial-level data from Lewis & Frank (2018a) , who conducted a large, multi-experiment replication of the suspicious-coincidence paradigm of Xu & Tenenbaum (2007a) with adults and made their data, stimuli, and code public. Because the exact images are available, we could compute, for every test item, its distance in the encoder’s space to the examples a participant had just seen, and ask whether that distance is associated with the participant’s decision to extend the word. The second is artificial: a learner that operates over the same frozen encoder, for which we fix which categories each word designates and measure whether the learner can name new images. The artificial learner is not a model of the adult participant; it is a controlled system in which the representation is fully known, so that the contribution of similarity in that space can be isolated.
blocks.zh: 我们综合了两个证据来源。 第一个是人类:我们重新分析来自Lewis & Frank(2018a)的试验级别数据,他们与成年人一起对徐和特能鲍姆(2007a)的可疑-巧合范式进行了大规模,多实验的复制,并公开了他们的数据,刺激和代码. 因为有准确的图像,我们可以计算每个测试项目在编码器空间的距离,以了解参与者刚刚看到的例子,并询问这一距离是否与参与者延长这个词的决定有关。 第二个是人工的:一个在同一个被冻结的编码器上操作的学习者,我们为此固定了每个字的分类,并测量学习者是否可以给新图像取名. 人工学习者不是成人参与者的模范;它是一个控制系统,其中代表完全为人所熟知,从而可以孤立出该空间中相似性的贡献.

blocks.en: The two parts address different behaviors. The adult decided how far to extend a word; the learner tried to recover a taught label. We therefore treat the comparison as a test of how far a shared similarity space describes both, not as evidence of a common mechanism. Our contributions are: • A secondary analysis of adult word extension showing that distance in a self-supervised visual space is associated with extension, and that its effect depends on the composition of the teaching examples (exploratory). • A controlled demonstration, in artificial learners, that the learnability of a two-category word decreases with the distance between its categories, with taxonomic relatedness adding no detectable prediction in the sample tested. • Confirmatory tests of two distinct links between the systems: the encoder’s geometry partially aligns with human similarity and confusability measures, but this representational alignment did not translate into conclusive evidence that human-derived distances predict which words the learner finds hard.
blocks.zh: 这两个部分涉及不同的行为. 成年人决定了一个字要延伸多远;学习者试图找回一个被教导的标签. 因此,我们把比较视为一种检验,检验一个共同的类似空间对两者的描述程度,而不是作为共同机制的证据。 我们的贡献是: · 对成人字扩展的二次分析,显示在自控视觉空间中的距离与扩展相关,其影响取决于教学实例的构成(探索). • 在人工学习者中,一个有控制的演示,即两个类别词的可学习性随着其类别之间的距离而降低,分类关联性在所测试的样本中增加了任何可探测的预测. 二. 支助 对两种不同系统之间联系的确认测试:编码器的几何部分与人类相似性和可调性测量方法一致,但这种代表式的校正并没有转化为确凿的证据,证明人类产生的距离可以预测学习者所发现的硬词。

blocks.en: 2 Adults: Visual Distance and the Composition of Examples
blocks.zh: 2 成年人:视觉距离和实例的构成

blocks.en: 2.1 Data
blocks.zh: 2.1 数据

blocks.en: Lewis & Frank (2018a) ran 12 online experiments with adults in the word-learning paradigm of Xu & Tenenbaum (2007a) . On each trial a novel word was taught with one subordinate example, three subordinate examples, three basic-level examples, or three superordinate examples (e.g., one Dalmatian; three Dalmatians; three dogs of different breeds; three different animals), and participants selected, from an array of 24 test images, all the objects that the word could also name. Of the 24 test items, 8 belonged to the taught domain (subordinate, basic-level, and superordinate matches); the rest came from other domains. The suspicious-coincidence effect is the reduction in basic-level generalization after three subordinate examples relative to one. Lewis & Frank (2018a) recovered the effect with a large effect size under both sequential and simultaneous presentation, but found it sensitive to trial order: it was absent, or reversed under sequential presentation, when the three-example trials preceded the one-example trial. We used their public, anonymized trial-level data and the original stimulus images. Participant identifiers in that release are assigned across experiments, so the data comprise 600 sessions from 520 distinct people (56 people took part more than once), 7,200 trials, and 172,800 item-level decisions.
blocks.zh: Lewis & Frank (2018a)在徐和特能鲍姆的文字学习范式(2007a)中与成年人进行了12个在线实验. 在每次试验中,都用一个从属的例子,三个从属的例子,三个基本层次的例子,或者三个超从属的例子(例如:一个达尔马提亚人;三个达尔马提亚人;三个不同品种的狗;三个不同的动物)来教新词,参与者从24个测试图像的阵列中选择了这个词也可以命名的所有对象. 在24个测试项目中,8个属于教学领域(附属、基础和超高级匹配);其余来自其他领域。 可疑-巧合效应是,在三个从属例子相对一个之后,基本层面的通论减少. Lewis & Frank (2018a) 在相继和相并列的演示中恢复了效果并具有较大效果大小,但发现其对于审判命令很敏感:在相并列的演示中缺席,或倒置,在一例审判之前进行三例审判. 我们使用了他们公开的,匿名的试验数据 和原始的刺激图像。 该版的参与者识别器是经过各种试验分配的,因此,数据包括600个会议,分别来自520个不同的人(56人不止一次参加)、7 200个审判和172 800个项目级决定。

blocks.en: 2.2 Visual Distance
blocks.zh: 2.2 视距

blocks.en: Each image was encoded with the same frozen DINOv2-small encoder used for the artificial learners ( Oquab et al., 2023a ) . For every trial and test item we computed d d , the cosine distance between the item’s L2-normalized embedding and the normalized centroid of the training examples shown on that trial. The distance is defined entirely by the images, independently of participants’ responses.
blocks.zh: 每个图像被用同样被冷冻的用于人工学习的DINOv2-小编码器编码(Oquab等,2023a.). 对于每个试验和测试项目,我们计算dd, 该项目L2-正态嵌入与该试验中显示的训练实例正态中间体之间的余弦相距。 距离完全由图像定义,独立于参与者的反应.

blocks.en: 2.3 Analysis
blocks.zh: 2.3 分析

blocks.en: The confirmatory hypothesis (H4 in the analysis plan) was that the probability of selecting a test item decreases with d d , controlling for the item’s taxonomic level and the teaching condition. We fitted a logistic mixed model, selected ∼ z ⁡ ( d ) + level + condition + ( 1 + z ⁡ ( d ) ∣ person ) + ( 1 ∣ image ) \mathrm{selected}\sim z(d)+\mathrm{level}+\mathrm{condition}+(1+z(d)\mid\mathrm{person})+(1\mid\mathrm{image}) , over all 24 items. Random effects are grouped by person, as the plan specified (Table 1 ; the Appendix). Support required a negative coefficient with Holm-adjusted p < .05 p<.05 within the six-test confirmatory family. Distance was standardized within each model, so a standard deviation corresponds to .219 cosine units over all 24 items and to .296 over the 8 target-domain items; coefficients from the two item sets are therefore not on exactly the same scale. Sensitivity analyses used only the 8 target-domain items, only each person’s first session (identified by its recorded start time), excluded people who participated more than once, or excluded the two experiments that were not preregistered by the original authors. The plan listed a distance × \times condition interaction as exploratory. A descriptive comparison of conditions and a post hoc test of the incremental contribution of distance were not part of the plan and are reported as exploratory. Two further post hoc exploratory analyses were specified after the main results were known, and before they were run (the Appendix). First, a superordinate-only model restricted to the four superordinate target-domain items of each trial (12 images) compared selected ∼ z ⁡ ( d ) + condition \mathrm{selected}\sim z(d)+\mathrm{condition} with models dropping either term, with random intercepts by person and image (sensitivity: adding a by-person distance slope). Second, a trial-order model used the experiment-level order of the one-example and three-example trials (one-example trial first or last; six experiments each) and tested, by likelihood ratio, whether order moderated the distance slope ( z ⁡ ( d ) × order z(d)\times\mathrm{order} , 1 df ) and the distance × \times condition interaction ( z ⁡ ( d ) × condition × order z(d)\times\mathrm{condition}\times\mathrm{order} , 3 df ), with Holm correction over these two tests. Order varies only between experiments and is therefore confounded with other experiment-level differences.

blocks.en: 2.4 Results
blocks.zh: 2.4 结果

blocks.en: Visual distance was associated with extension: the log odds of selecting an item fell by − - 3.226 per standard deviation of distance (95% CI [ − - 3.288, − - 3.164]; Holm-adjusted p < .001 p<.001 ), with level and condition in the model. The estimate was stable across specifications (Table 2 ): − - 3.16 with only the 8 target-domain items, − - 3.17 with first sessions only, − - 3.12 excluding repeat participants, and − - 3.11 combining the last restriction with target items. Over all 24 items, however, the coefficient is dominated by the contrast between the taught domain and the other domains, whose items were almost never selected. The target-only analyses address this. In an exploratory post hoc comparison restricted to the 8 target-domain items, adding distance to a model with level and condition (and the same random intercepts) improved fit markedly (likelihood ratio χ 2 ​ ( 1 ) = 3,017.0 \chi^{2}(1)=3,017.0 , Δ ​ AIC = 3,015.0 \Delta\mathrm{AIC}=3,015.0 ; χ 2 ​ ( 3 ) = 3,695.4 \chi^{2}(3)=3,695.4 when the by-person distance slope was also added). Within each taxonomic level the distance slope was negative: − - 4.22 [ − - 4.46, − - 3.98] for subordinate, − - 3.21 [ − - 3.40, − - 3.03] for basic-level, and − - 0.94 [ − - 1.25, − - 0.62] for superordinate items (log odds per target-model standard deviation). Distance and level remain correlated by construction in this stimulus set, so these estimates describe an association beyond the coded level, not a separable causal contribution of similarity.

blocks.en: 3 Artificial Learners: A Controlled System
blocks.zh: 3 人工学习者:一个受控制的系统

blocks.en: The adult data show an association but cannot isolate the role of similarity, because the experimenter does not control the representation the participant uses. In an artificial learner the representation is known and the extension of each word can be fixed. We summarize the core results of the artificial-learner study (full details of the original experiments are in Vera (2026a) and in the project repository).
blocks.zh: 成人数据显示一个关联,但不能孤立相似性的作用,因为实验者并不控制参与者使用的代表. 在人工学习者中,代表是已知的,每个词的延伸可以固定. 我们总结了人工收取器研究的核心结果(原始实验的全部细节见Vera (2026a)和项目存储器).

blocks.en: 3.1 Method
blocks.zh: 3.1 方法

blocks.en: Images from CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 ( Krizhevsky, 2009a ) were encoded once with frozen DINOv2-small ( Oquab et al., 2023a ) (384-dimensional CLS embeddings, L2-normalized). Images were preprocessed with the model’s default Hugging Face image processor: conversion to RGB, bicubic resizing of the shorter side to 256 pixels (the 32 × \times 32 CIFAR images are therefore upsampled), a 224 × \times 224 center crop, rescaling to [0, 1], and normalization with ImageNet means and standard deviations. The same preprocessing was applied to the stimulus images of the adult study. We did not test alternative preprocessing choices (e.g., other interpolation methods or crops). Learners received nonce words (e.g., slithy , mimsy , vorpal ; Carroll, 1871a ) paired with five images each, in 3-way episodes, and were tested on naming held-out images. The main learner represents a word by the normalized mean of its training embeddings (a prototype; equivalent to a prototypical network over a frozen encoder; Snell et al., 2017a ); exemplar ( k k -nearest-neighbor) and logistic-regression learners gave the same pattern. Each word was assigned either one category (native) or two categories (disjunctive). Disjunctive words were grouped into near, mid, and far tiers by the cosine distance between the two categories’ centroids (mean .359, .559, and .694). For example, tromble (cat + dog) and mivor (frog + truck) both join exactly two categories; what differs is the distance between them. Thirty paired episodes per condition were run (seed 42), with 95% bootstrap intervals over episodes. The tiers contain few words (3, 3, and 4 category pairs for near, mid, and far), so these intervals reflect episode-level variability and do not generalize over words; the dissociation study below addresses generalization over pairs.

blocks.en: To separate distance in the encoder’s space from taxonomic relatedness, a dissociation study on CIFAR-100 sampled 100 category pairs from the four quadrants formed by median splits of perceptual (DINOv2) distance and semantic distance (one minus WordNet Wu–Palmer similarity; Wu & Palmer, 1994a ; Miller, 1995a ), taught each pair as one word, and regressed naming accuracy on both distances, under decision rules specified in advance in an internal plan. The reported dissociation results use the original, pre-specified mapping of class names to WordNet synsets. That mapping selected an unintended sense for 21 classes (e.g., tiger as a fierce person; 42 of the 100 sampled pairs involve at least one of them); with these senses corrected, the conclusion was unchanged (perceptual β = \beta= - 0.223 0.223 , semantic p = 0.718 p=0.718 , versus - 0.212 0.212 and 0.660 with the original mapping; with quadrants reassigned, median accuracy remained higher in Q4 than in Q3, .863 vs. .838, n = 35 n=35 discordant pairs). Details are in the released materials.

blocks.en: 3.2 Results
blocks.zh: 3.2 结果

blocks.en: Naming accuracy was 94.3% [92.2, 96.1] for native words and fell to 84.7% [83.2, 86.1], 65.4% [63.7, 67.2], and 53.0% [51.0, 55.0] for near, mid, and far disjunctive words (chance ≈ 33 % \approx 33\% ; Figure 2 ). The ordering was the same for every non-random learner and replicated across five master seeds. In the dissociation study, perceptual distance predicted accuracy ( β = \beta= - 0.212 0.212 , p = 1.87 × 10 − 7 p=1.87\times 10^{-7} , partial R 2 = 0.245 R^{2}=0.245 ), whereas semantic distance did not ( p = 0.660 p=0.660 , partial R 2 = 0.002 R^{2}=0.002 ; Figure 3 ); sharing a CIFAR-100 superclass did not add detectable prediction once perceptual distance was controlled ( β = 0.015 \beta=0.015 , p = 0.528 p=0.528 ). Because the learner has no access to semantic information, this is a sufficiency result: distance in the learner’s own space suffices to produce the gradient; it does not show that semantics is irrelevant for human learners. Pairs within the same superclass were, on average, learned more accurately (91.5% vs. 84.5%), but only 6 of the 100 pairs fell within a superclass.

blocks.en: 4 Testing the Link Between the Two Systems
blocks.zh: 4 测试两个系统之间的联系

blocks.en: The two results above use the same similarity space, but the adult result does not show that this space captures human similarity, and the learner result does not show that human similarity predicts learning. We tested these two distinct relations, alignment between similarity measures (H1) and prediction of learner difficulty from human distances (H2), with public human datasets, under the same analysis plan.
blocks.zh: 以上两项结果使用相同的相似性空间,但成人结果并未显示这个空间能捕捉到人类的相似性,而学习者的结果也未显示人类的相似性能预测学习. 我们在同一个分析计划下,用公共的人类数据集测试了这两种截然不同的关系,即相似度度量(H1)和从人类距离(H2)预测学习者难度。

blocks.en: 4.1 Data
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据

blocks.en: We used three independent human datasets that cover CIFAR categories: odd-one-out similarity judgments for THINGS concepts ( Hebart et al., 2020a ; Hebart et al., 2023a ) , similarity judgments for ImageNet images (ImageNet-HSJ; Roads & Love, 2021a ), and human classification uncertainty for the CIFAR-10 test set (CIFAR-10H; Peterson et al., 2019a ). Each was converted to a distance between category pairs. CIFAR-100 classes were mapped to THINGS concepts by name and WordNet sense, with ambiguous names resolved to the sense shown in the CIFAR images (e.g., mouse as the rodent, tank as the military vehicle); 83 classes were mapped. Three classes that share a single THINGS concept (maple, oak, and willow, all mapped to tree ) kept their mapping, but the pairs among them were excluded, which yields 3,400 pairs; cattle and ray have only hyponym matches in THINGS and were used only in a stricter sensitivity mapping. For ImageNet-HSJ, each CIFAR class was assigned the ImageNet synsets in the hyponym closure of its WordNet synset (synsets claimed by more than one class went to the most specific class, and exact ties were dropped); 68 CIFAR-100 classes received at least one synset, and pairs were retained when at least 10 relevant judgments were available, yielding 1,390 pairs. CIFAR-10H uses the CIFAR-10 classes directly. Robustness checks with alternative mappings are in the released materials. All mappings were fixed before human distances were computed. THINGS and ImageNet-HSJ judgments reflect both perceptual and conceptual properties of objects ( Hebart et al., 2020a ) , and CIFAR-10H measures confusability rather than similarity; none of them is a pure measure of visual similarity. Confirmatory tests (H1 × \times 3, H2 × \times 2, H4) were Holm-corrected as one family.

CIFAR-100类被以名称和WordNet感来映射到MOTES概念上,而模棱两可的名称被CIFAR图像(例如老鼠为啮齿动物,坦克为军用车辆)所显示的感而解决;83类被映射出. 三个类都有一个单一的事物概念(枫,橡树和柳,都被映射到树上),它们保持了它们的映射,但其中的对子被排除在外,它们能产生出3,400对;牛和射线在事物中只有下名匹配,并且只在更严格的灵敏度映射中使用. 对于ImageNet-HSJ来说,每个CIFAR类都被分配到其WordNet synset的下行Nym闭合中的ImageNet synsets(一个以上类声称的synset去到最具体类,并放弃了确切的链接);68个CIFAR-100类至少收到一个synset,在至少有10个相关判断时保留了一对,产生1,390对. blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: We asked how much visual similarity explains when two objects share a name, and what the teaching examples add. In adults, distance in a self-supervised visual space was associated with the decision to extend a novel word across specifications, and, in an exploratory post hoc test, it added to taxonomic level and teaching condition within the taught domain. In artificial learners operating over the same space, words joining more distant categories were harder to learn, and taxonomic relatedness did not predict accuracy beyond perceptual distance in this sample (only 6 of 100 pairs fell within a superclass); because the learner has no access to semantic information, this is a sufficiency result. The encoder’s geometry aligned partially with three independent human measures of similarity and confusability. Taken together, these results suggest that a shared, partly human-aligned similarity space describes part of the organization of generalization in both systems.
blocks.zh: 我们问,当两个物体共用一个名称时,视觉相似性解释了多少,教学实例增加了什么。 在成人中,自我监督的视觉空间中的距离与将一个新词跨出规格的决定有关,在探索性后特设测试中,它增加了教学领域的分类水平和教学条件. 在在同一空间操作的人工学习者中,加入更远的分类的词比较难被学习,分类学关联性在这个样本中没有预测出超出知觉距离的精度(100对中只有6对掉入了超类);因为学习者无法获得语义信息,这是充分的结果. 编码器的几何部分与三种相似性和相容性的独立人类测量方法一致. 综合起来,这些结果表明,一个共同的、部分与人类相通的相似性空间描述了两个系统中通论组织的一部分。

blocks.en: The limits are as informative as the associations. First, in adults the composition of the examples changed extension dramatically at comparable distances: three superordinate examples licensed broad extension, whereas three subordinate examples suppressed it, and, in an exploratory analysis, the slope of distance itself depended on the teaching condition. This is the kind of evidence-sensitive inference that Bayesian accounts emphasize ( Xu & Tenenbaum, 2007a ) and that Lewis & Frank (2018a) showed to be sensitive to trial order; the distance-to-centroid measure we used does not, by itself, account for these differences between conditions. In our exploratory post hoc models, terms involving experiment-level trial order improved fit, and within superordinate items both condition and distance improved fit given the other; because order is confounded with other experiment-level differences, we do not interpret these terms further. Second, representational alignment did not translate into conclusive evidence that human distances predict learner difficulty: the encoder’s geometry aligned partially with human measures (H1), but human-derived distances did not reliably predict which words the learner found difficult (H2, inconclusive; one dataset showed an effect in the predicted direction that did not survive correction). Correlation between two representational spaces does not guarantee that both predict learning in the same way. Third, the pair-level learner effect did not reappear with an encoder trained on child experience, so it may depend on properties of the specific encoder. And because THINGS and ImageNet-HSJ mix perceptual and conceptual information, the alignment we observe cannot be attributed to perceptual similarity alone.
blocks.zh: 限制与协会一样翔实。 首先,在成人中,实例的构成在可比距离上发生了巨大的变化:三个超级实例允许扩展,而三个从属实例压制了扩展,在一项探索性分析中,距离的坡度本身取决于教学条件。 这就是贝叶斯人的说法所强调(Xu & Tenenenbaum, 2007a)和刘易斯和弗兰克(2018a)所显示的对审判命令敏感的证据敏感的推断;我们使用的距离与中心机器人测量方法本身并不能说明这些条件之间的差异. 在我们的探索性后特设模型中,涉及实验一级试验令的术语更加合适,在超超高级项目中,条件和距离也更加适合另一个;由于秩序与其他实验级别差异是混淆的,我们不对这些术语作进一步解释。 第二,代表式的校正没有转化为人行距离预测学习者难度的确凿证据:编码器的几何部分与人行度(H1)一致,但人行距离并不能可靠地预测学习者发现的字眼难度(H2,无定论;一个数据集显示出了对预测方向的影响,无法在校正后幸存). 两个代表空间之间的关联并不能保证两者以同样的方式预测学习. 第三,配对级的学习者效应没有重新出现,而有一个经过了儿童体验训练的编码器,因此它可能依赖于特定编码器的特性. 而由于MthingS和ImageNet-HSJ混合了知觉和概念信息,我们观察到的对齐不能仅仅归因于知觉相似性.

blocks.en: We therefore claim similarity in the organization of generalization, not a shared mechanism. The adult and the learner performed different tasks, measured on different scales (Figure 1 ), and the learner has no access to the pragmatic and sampling considerations that adults bring to the task. The value of the artificial system is that it isolates one factor, similarity in a known space, and shows what that factor alone can and cannot produce.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们声称,在一般化的组织上是相似的,而不是一个共同的机制。 成人和学习者执行不同的任务,按不同尺度衡量(图1),学习者无法利用成人给任务带来的务实和抽样考虑。 人工系统的价值在于它孤立出一个因素,在已知的空间中的相似性,并表明这个因素单独能够和不能产生什么.

blocks.en: 5.1 Limitations
blocks.zh: 5.1 限制

blocks.en: All human data are secondary. The experiments were designed by other teams for other questions, with different stimuli, tasks, and participants, and we could not alter their designs. The adult analysis is correlational: distance and taxonomic level are related by construction in the stimulus sets, and although models control for level and condition, distance in DINOv2 is one of many possible similarity measures. The descriptive contrast between conditions and the interaction model are exploratory. The H2 analyses had small samples (61 and 32 pairs). All learner results rest on frozen encoders and CIFAR images, two-category words, and shallow learners; only the final-layer CLS embedding was used. The human mixed models include random intercepts by image but no by-image random slopes for distance, so heterogeneity across images in sensitivity to distance was not estimated. The CIFAR-10 tier intervals are episode-level and do not separate pair-level variability. Taxonomic relatedness was measured only with WordNet Wu–Palmer similarity, with few within-superclass pairs. The two post hoc analyses of trial order and superordinate items were specified before being run but after the data had been analyzed, and trial order varied between experiments, together with other design features. The previous multi-agent consensus experiments of this project are reported in Vera (2026a) and are not part of this article.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusions and Future Work
blocks.zh: 6. 结论和今后的工作

blocks.en: We asked how much visual similarity explains when two objects share a name, and what the teaching examples add. Distance in a frozen self-supervised visual space was associated with adult word extension across confirmatory specifications, and, in an exploratory post hoc analysis, it added to taxonomic level and teaching condition within the taught domain. Distance was not the whole story. At comparable distances, three superordinate examples licensed broad extension to superordinate test items, whereas three subordinate examples suppressed it, and, in an exploratory analysis, the slope of distance itself depended on how the word was taught. The distance-to-centroid measure we used does not, by itself, account for these differences between conditions.
blocks.zh: 我们问,当两个物体共用一个名称时,视觉相似性解释了多少,教学实例增加了什么。 被冻结的自我监督的视觉空间的距离与成人字词跨越确认规格有关,在一次探索性事后分析中,它增加了教学范围内的分类水平和教学条件。 距离不是整个故事。 在可比较的距离上,有三个超坐标的例子允许将广义扩展至超坐标试验项目,而三个从属的例子压制了它,在一项探索性分析中,距离的坡度本身取决于这个词是如何被教授的. 我们使用的距离与中心机器人测量方法本身并不能说明不同条件之间的这些差异。

blocks.en: In artificial learners operating over the same encoder, words joining more distant categories were harder to learn, and taxonomic relatedness added no detectable prediction beyond perceptual distance in the sample tested. Because the learner has no access to semantic information, this is a sufficiency result, not evidence that semantics is irrelevant for human learners. The encoder’s geometry aligned partially with three independent human measures of similarity and confusability, and that alignment cannot be attributed to perceptual similarity alone. This alignment did not translate into conclusive evidence that human-derived distances predict learner difficulty: one estimate was small and its interval included zero; another was in the predicted direction but did not survive correction; both samples were small. A second encoder, trained on one child’s experience, reproduced the tier ordering but not the pair-level effect, so that effect may depend on properties of the specific encoder. We do not draw conclusions from the age-of-acquisition analysis.
blocks.zh: 在同一编码器上操作的人工学习者中,加入更远的分类的词比较难于被学习,分类关联性在被测试的样本中除了能感知到的距离之外,没有增加任何可探测的预测. 由于学习者无法获取语义信息,因此这是一个充分的结果,而不是证明语义与人类学习者无关的证据. 编码器的几何部分与三种相似性和相容性的独立人类度量法相配合,这种相通性不能仅仅归因于知觉相近. 这种校正没有转化为人源距离预测学习者困难的确凿证据:一个估计数很小,其间隔包括0;另一个在预测方向上,但未能幸存;两个样本都很小. 根据一个孩子的经验培训的第二个编码器复制了一级顺序,而不是对等效应,因此这种效应可能取决于具体编码器的特性。 我们没有从采购年龄分析中得出结论。

blocks.en: We therefore claim similarity in the organization of generalization, not a shared mechanism. The adult and the learner performed different tasks, measured on different scales, and the learner has no access to the pragmatic and sampling considerations that adults bring to the task. All human data are secondary, and the adult analysis is correlational: distance and taxonomic level are related by construction in the stimulus sets. Visual similarity accounts for part of how generalization is organized in both systems, while the composition of examples contributes what the distance we used does not capture.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们声称,在一般化的组织上是相似的,而不是一个共同的机制。 成人和学习者执行不同的任务,按不同尺度衡量,学习者无法利用成人给任务带来的务实和抽样考虑。 所有人类数据都是次要的,而成人分析是相通的:距离和分类水平通过刺激集中的构建来相通. 视觉相似性是两个系统中的通论组织方式的一部分,而实例的构成则贡献了我们使用的距离不捕捉的内容.

blocks.en: The most direct next step is an experiment with children using the artificial learner’s categories: teaching novel words for near, mid, and far two-category unions, and for single categories with subordinate, basic, or superordinate examples, would test whether the gradient observed in the learner, and the composition effect observed in adults, appear in the same individuals and with the same images. A closely related question is whether the same pattern holds for another vision encoder. The child-experience encoder we examined already shows that the pair-level learner effect need not reappear; tests with language-supervised encoders such as CLIP ( Radford et al., 2021a ) , other self-supervised encoders, intermediate layers, and patch-level features would show how far the present associations, and the partial alignment with human measures, depend on the frozen final-layer CLS embeddings we used. Further robustness checks include by-image random slopes for distance in the adult models; alternative distance aggregations and image preprocessing; pair-level resampling or hierarchical models for the CIFAR-10 tiers; richer semantic controls (human relatedness norms or distributional semantics) with sampling targeted at within-superclass pairs; and greater coverage for the test of human-derived distances against learner difficulty, with more category pairs and additional human datasets.

blocks.en: Appendix A History of Corrections to the Human-Data Analyses
blocks.zh: 附录A 人类数据分析修正史

blocks.en: This appendix summarizes the history of the human-data analyses; the released deviation log documents each step with its scripts and outputs. The analysis plan specified random effects by participant identifier. Our first implementation grouped random effects by experiment × \times identifier, assuming that identifiers were reused across experiments for different people. An external review of the analyses pointed out that the original authors assigned identifiers after pooling the twelve experiments, so that one identifier is one person; we verified this in their anonymization script and re-estimated all H4 models, including the planned exploratory interaction, with random effects by person. The conclusions did not change. The person-level first-session sensitivity analysis was then redefined by each session’s recorded start time. In the descriptive comparison of conditions, equivalent condition labels spelled differently across experiments were unified after an error was found; the H4 models were not affected. The test of the incremental contribution of distance within the taught domain was added after an internal critical review. The superordinate-only and trial-order models were specified after an automated external review of the manuscript, when the main results were already known; their specifications were written into the deviation log before they were run.
blocks.zh: 本附录总结了人类数据分析的历史;所发布的偏差日志记录了每一步骤及其脚本和产出. 分析计划通过参与者识别符指定了随机效应. 我们的首次执行通过实验\\时间标识将随机效应归为一类,假设识别符在实验中被重复用于不同的人. 对分析进行的外部审查指出,最初的作者在汇集了十二个实验之后分配了识别符,因此一个识别符就是一个人;我们在他们的匿名文字中验证了这一点并重新估计了所有H4模型,包括计划中的探索性互动,并按人随机产生效果. 结论没有改变。 然后,按每届会议记录的开始时间重新界定了对人一级会议敏感性的分析。 在描述性的条件比较中,发现出错后统一了各种实验中拼写不同的等同条件标签;H4模型没有受到影响. 经过内部批判性审查,增加了对教学领域距离的递增贡献的测试。 在对手稿进行自动化的外部审查之后,即主要结果已经知道的情况下,规定了只具有超度的和试验顺序的模型;它们的规格在运行前被写入了偏差日志.
